title: Go where ego comes off
summary: The sight of the saints becomes a cleansing bath where self-concern can finally come off.
takeaway: Seek the company that makes ego unnecessary.
lifeApplication: When you feel sticky with self-concern, do not stay private. Sit near the one whose presence makes performance unnecessary and let that company do its work.

source.shortMeaning: The saints' presence is a complete cleansing bath for the self that cannot scrub itself clean.
source.lifeApplication: When self-concern thickens, move toward the company whose humility makes performance feel unnecessary.

evidence.coreClaim: The saints' presence is a complete cleansing bath for the self that cannot scrub itself clean.
evidence.turn: Let holy presence wash what private self-improvement keeps rehearsing.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you feel sticky with self-concern, do not stay private. Sit near the one whose presence makes performance unnecessary and let that company do its work.
